scope: Necessary conditions for every complex pure symmetric twelve-qubit third-order anticoherent state at any double Majorana point. These do not globally exclude partition (2,2,2,2,1,1,1,1).

doublePointProbability.definition: After rotating a double root to z=0, c0=c1=0 and p2=|c2|².
doublePointProbability.lowerEndpointExcluded: Only c2*c3bar and c9*c10bar contribute to J+. Their nonzero magnitudes and the independent {Jz,J+} equation force an impossible simultaneous A+B=0 and -7A+7B=0.
doublePointProbability.upperEndpointExcluded: The sole adjacent support pair8,9 gives a nonzero J+ expectation.

doublePointSeparation.coordinate: q=tan(theta/2)^2, theta is the angular separation of two distinct double points.
doublePointSeparation.positivityJustification: A*D-q*(A prime)^2 is a Gram determinant of two independent evaluation/derivative vectors for every q>0.
doublePointSeparation.exactAngularThreshold: 2*atan(sqrt(q_star)), where q_star is the unique positive root of definingPolynomial.
doublePointSeparation.numericalScope: Floating angles approximate the exact threshold; they are not asserted to be outward-rounded interval bounds. Antipodal pairs satisfy the separation bound automatically.
doublePointSeparation.conclusion: Every pair of distinct double points has angular separation strictly greater than this bound.

interpretation: The repeated points cannot themselves approach one another in an exact3AC state. Simple points may still coalesce into additional double points; the double-octahedral boundary therefore remains possible.
